description: Rename a dashboard, set how long each view is shown when the dashboard auto-rotates on a screen, or set the test customer used to preview a customer dashboard. Use set_dashboard_theme for colours and publish_dashboard for sharing.

testCustomerId.description: A customer identifier from your own data, used to preview a customer dashboard before real customers exist. This is bound to :customer_id during previews only.

viewRotationSeconds.description: Seconds each view is shown before rotating to the next, for wall displays. 0 or null turns rotation off.

name: update_dashboard
title: Update a dashboard
